zh.heroTitle: 兩個人，一個令香港人出行簡單啲嘅想法。
zh.heroDesc: Datatune 是由 2 位創辦人組成的小型開發團隊。我們由設計、開發、行銷到客戶支援都親自參與，只為打造真正切合香港人需要的交通應用。
zh.whyParagraph1: 故事其實好簡單。當時每日返工都要轉幾程車——巴士轉地鐵，再考慮轉東涌線抑或直接搭落中環。最困擾係每次都去到葵芳先諗起要 check 下荔景幾時有車，要開幾個 App 又要逐個等佢 load。
zh.whyParagraph2: 忽發奇想：點解冇一個 App 可以整合香港所有交通工具的到站時間，重點係 load 得要夠快！於是，我哋決定自己整合一個 App 完全涵蓋各種交通工具，直至今天，港九新界巴士、小巴、港鐵、輕鐵、渡輪，全都有齊。
zh.quote:
技術應該服務生活，
而不是打擾生活。
zh.contactTitle:
有問題、建議，
或者純粹想傾兩句？
zh.contactDesc: 我們很樂意聽到你的想法。每一個意見，都可能成為下一個改善。
zh.footerTitle: 感謝使用 Datatune 嘅每一位。
zh.footerDesc: 有你們嘅支持，我哋先可以持續進步同堅持做落去。
zh.footerSlogan: 趕巴士，從此唔使再被迫睇廣告。

en.heroTitle: Two people, one idea to make commuting easier for Hongkongers.
en.heroDesc: Datatune is a small dev team of 2 founders. We handle design, development, marketing, and support ourselves, just to build a transit app that truly fits Hong Kong people.
en.whyParagraph1: The story is simple. Commuting used to be a hassle, switching between buses and MTR. The worst part was remembering to check bus times at Kwai Fong, having to open multiple apps and wait for them to load.
en.whyParagraph2: We wondered: why isn't there one app integrating all HK transit times, that loads fast? So we built it. Today, we cover buses, minibuses, MTR, light rail, and ferries.
en.quote:
Tech should serve life,
not disturb it.
en.contactTitle:
Questions, suggestions,
or just want to chat?
en.contactDesc: We love hearing your ideas. Every feedback could be our next improvement.
en.footerDesc: With your support, we can keep improving.
en.footerSlogan: No more forced ads when catching a bus.
